简介: Lesli Linka Glatter (sometimes credited as Leslie Linka Glatter) (born 1953) began as a dancer and choreographer before becoming a film director. Her first film, Tales of Meeting and Parting (1984), jointly directed with Sharon Oreck, was nominated for an Academy Award in the Live Action Short Film category. She has made several television films for cable networks, but the majority of her work is in television series.
